expectations.text: Treats the criteria agreed before the event as what makes the missed quota discussable rather than an argument
expectations.evidence: The response grounds the shortfall in written criteria. It says to 'Pull the signed clause. Does it state criteria and a remedy?' It says to count as booked only meetings that 'passed the criteria check', to 're-verify the six... fit the written criteria, not just a job title', and to require 'a guarantee with written criteria' next year. It also says that without a clause, 'you are in the "number with nothing behind it" case' and what you offer is 'goodwill rather than contract'. However, it never says outright that pre-agreed criteria are what turn the shortfall into a shared, checkable fact
